title: Industrial Plant Clarifier Construction, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle black and white photograph documenting the construction of a large-scale industrial facility or municipal water treatment plant. In the foreground, a rotating steel bridge and truss rake mechanism sits atop a concrete basin or clarifier foundation. The background features heavy machinery, towering construction cranes, concrete building frames, and a large cylindrical storage tank under a clear sky.
